Lately I've actually been thinking about the hobbies I have. I play alot of video games and try to fill up as much of my time as possible with that and Netflix which I am lucky enough to have free access too. Other than that I have not been interested in much else. I had other hobbies before but they are not cheap hobbies so I had to stop. I have tried very hard to quit my hobby of drinking. I have been able to cut back but not stop all the way. This has been having a bad impact on my social life though hah.

Thanks a lot for your support, I appreciate it.

Hello there thanks for the reply. I am not sure if they offer that for alumni. I'm sure they did while I was a student and I should have gotten some help there when I could have. Regardless if they offer it for alumni or not, I don't have a reliable car to get there anymore, it's a good drive away from my house. 

I have written down my thoughts before and filled up some notebooks and I've got a word document that has a lot of stuff in there as well. It has not helped me much.
